title: Corrugate
summary: CORRUGATE, verb transitive [Latin , to wrinkle, in our vulgar language, to ruck, to furrow.] To wrinkle; to draw or contract into folds; as, to corrugate the skin. CORRUGATE, adjective Wrinkled.
